scripts.title: Neo-Retro Sanctuary
scripts.logline: A steadfast shopkeeper protects his archive of animated legends from surging chaos as neighborhood youths rally to his side.
scripts.logline_de: Ein standhafter Ladenbesitzer verteidigt sein Archiv animierter Legenden vor aufkommendem Chaos, während Jugendliche aus dem Viertel ihm zur Seite stehen.

setting.location: Neo-Veridia shopping district, general urban street
setting.weather: Windy, scattered debris blowing across asphalt
setting.color_palette: Gritty desaturated urban tones with vivid neon pink and electric blue accents
setting.art_style: 1990s retro anime, cel shading, film grain, dramatic hand-drawn look, vibrant poster hues

characters.name: Ren
characters.design_sheet: 1990s anime style, 32-year-old man, round wire-rimmed glasses (different from real life), short messy dark-green hair, determined expression, wearing an oversized black hoodie with embroidered abstract crest, dark cargo pants, heavy combat boots
changed_de: Kurze dunkelgrüne Haare statt realer Frisur
characters.voice: Deep, raspy 90s dub voice with immense emotional weight and gritty determination

characters.name: Maya
characters.design_sheet: 1990s anime style, 18-year-old young woman, long straight crimson hair tied in a high ponytail, sharp determined eyes, wearing a white utility jacket over a checkered flannel shirt, dark jeans, canvas sneakers
inspired_by_scene_de: Rolle als deeskalierende und schützende Passantin
characters.voice: Clear, energetic, and sharp young heroine voice, fierce yet compassionate

shots.camera: Wide angle, dramatic low angle looking up at shattered storefront, intense shake
shots.action: Glass shatters outward in a burst of speed lines as chaos erupts in front of the vintage store.
shots.music: High-tempo 90s cyberpunk synth-rock riff starts abruptly
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, shattered storefront glass on asphalt, dynamic wide angle, dramatic dark shadows, film grain, intense street chaos
shots.motion_prompt: Camera pushes forward rapidly through flying glass shards with heavy motion blur and speed lines.

shots.camera: Medium close-up, Dutch angle, fast pan
shots.action: Ren steps into the shattered entryway, dark hoodie snapping in the wind, eyes glowing with fierce determination.
shots.music: Synth riff continues with driving drum beat
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, 32-year-old man Ren with short messy dark-green hair, round wire-rimmed glasses, oversized black hoodie, fierce expression, standing in a broken shop entrance, dramatic neon rim lighting
shots.motion_prompt: Camera zooms in on Ren's face as energy aura flashes around his silhouette; impact frame on 'history'.

shots.action: Ren's eyes narrow behind his glasses, reflecting the neon signs and flying debris.
shots.voiceover: This place... holds every dream we ever drew.
shots.music: Music drops to a tense, rhythmic pulse
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, extreme close-up of Ren's intense eyes behind round glasses reflecting neon city lights, detailed cel animation style, dramatic shadow
shots.motion_prompt: Slow zoom into the pupil with a subtle pulsing light reflection and chromatic aberration.

shots.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot looking out at the chaotic street
shots.action: Silhouetted figures surge forward past littered pavement while Ren stands his ground at the threshold.
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, over-the-shoulder view of Ren in black hoodie facing a chaotic crowd in a littered urban street, vintage anime art style, grainy texture
shots.motion_prompt: Camera pans slightly right following a shadowy figure rushing past in the foreground with strong speed lines.

shots.action: An aggressive figure rushes up behind Ren and strikes a sudden blow, catching him off guard.
shots.music: Percussion hits hard on the impact frame
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, Ren stumbling forward from an impact, stylized action lines radiating outward, shattered glass on floor, dramatic high-contrast lighting
shots.motion_prompt: Fast horizontal whip-pan with impact frames and white flash on the hit.

shots.action: Ren stumbles into the display area against the wall, dropping his gaze in shock before clenching his fists.
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, Ren leaning against a ruined shop wall next to a torn vintage anime poster, bruised cheek, tight fists, dramatic cel shadows
shots.motion_prompt: Camera slowly tilts down from Ren's face to his clenched fists trembling with restrained energy.

shots.action: Maya suddenly steps between Ren and the approaching hostile figures, arms spread wide to halt them.

dialogue.line: Stop right there! Back off now!

shots.music: Heroic melodic synth lead swells up instantly
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, 18-year-old Maya with long crimson hair in ponytail, white utility jacket, standing defiantly in front of Ren with arms spread, dramatic anime lighting
shots.motion_prompt: Camera zooms in quickly on Maya's resolute expression as wind whips her hair across her face.

shots.camera: Close-up on Ren looking up in surprise
shots.action: Ren looks up from the threshold, his eyes widening in disbelief as support arrives from unexpected allies.
shots.music: Uplifting brass synth joins the melody
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, close-up of Ren's surprised face behind round glasses, wide glowing eyes, warm rim light from the streetlamps
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle slow-motion effect with sparkling light particles floating past the lens.

shots.action: More neighborhood youths step forward beside Maya, forming an unbreakable defensive wall.

dialogue.line: We grew up in these streets. We defend what's ours!

shots.music: Full symphonic 90s anime battle theme peaks
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, group of diverse youths standing shoulder to shoulder in front of the ruined shop, energetic glowing outlines, dramatic heroic pose, classic cel art
shots.motion_prompt: Camera pans across the group with rising energy auras flickering around each character.

shots.camera: Wide dynamic shot, slight Dutch angle
shots.action: A brilliant burst of golden energy flares outward from the group, driving back the encroaching crowd with sheer force.
shots.music: Climax of the theme song with electric guitar solo
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, massive golden energy shockwave erupting from the storefront, rioters stepping back in awe, glowing particles, vintage anime aesthetic
shots.motion_prompt: Rapid outward zoom with massive speed lines and a flash of white light filling the frame.

shots.camera: Close-up on Ren's face, determined smile
shots.action: Ren stands tall inside the shattered frame, a fierce yet calm smile on his face as he grips his hoodie straps.
shots.music: Music transitions into an inspiring, heroic outro melody
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, close-up of Ren smiling confidently amidst debris, wind blowing his dark-green hair, dramatic warm sunset lighting behind him
shots.motion_prompt: Camera holds steady with a gentle breathing motion on Ren's upper body.

shots.action: The dust settles in front of the damaged shop; Ren and Maya stand side by side looking forward into the evening light.
shots.voiceover: Some stories can never be erased.
shots.music: Melodic synthesizer chords fading into a warm ambient pad
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, wide shot of Ren and Maya standing calmly before the ruined storefront under a twilight sky, retro anime cel aesthetic, soft film grain
shots.motion_prompt: Slow, cinematic fade out with gentle swaying motion of papers on the ground.

source.event: Vor einem Ladenlokal in einer Einkaufsstraße liegen Scherben und Gegenstände auf dem Boden. Ein Mann verteidigt den beschädigten Eingangsbereich eines Geschäfts, wird dabei von Passanten konfrontiert und körperlich angegriffen. Umstehende greifen deeskalierend ein und rufen zum Aufhören auf, woraufhin der Mann sichtbar mitgenommen im zerstörten Schaufensterrahmen stehen bleibt.
